greeting: Egameni likaYise, neleNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, sihawukele. Kristu, sihawukele. Nkosi, sihawukele.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona intombi encinci, uMariya, enyuka izinyuko zetempile. Akukho mkhosi umlandelayo, akukho zihlwele zinkulu zimkhwazayo. NguMariya nje, umntwana oselula, okhokelwa luthando lwakhe olungapheliyo kuThixo. Unyuka izinyuko, inyathelo ngenyathelo, ezinikezela ngokupheleleyo. Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Ukunikezela. Le yindlela uMariya awaqala ngayo uhambo lwakhe, ukunikezela konke awayenakho kuThixo. UBenjamin Vo wayenalo olo hlobo lokunikezela entliziyweni yakhe. Khumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen, eneminyaka eli-15, wathi kubazali bakhe ufuna ukunika yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube, wayengazange ayityumze—isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayekulungele ukunika konke. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka xa ethetha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku.

KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo namhlanje, uYohane ubona 'amangqina amabini' amele phambi kweNkosi yomhlaba. 'Aziyiyo imithi yomnquma emibini neziphatho zezibane ezimbini,' utsho. Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Izibane ezimbini. UBen noRyan babefana nezi zibane ezimbini. Xa uBen wayephila, wayephila ngokukhanya. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukuhamba nehlabathi, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Xa uBen wayephila, wayephila ngokukhanya. Kwaye nangoku, nangona engasekho emzimbeni, ukukhanya kwakhe kusaqhubeka. Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, amaSadusi azama ukubambisa uYesu ngombuzo malunga novuko. 'Ngubani oya kuba ngumyeni walo mfazi?' bayabuza. UYesu uyaphendula: 'Kuye, bonke baphila.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… 'Kuye, bonke baphila.' Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, lo muncu uyakwazi ukuba nzima kakhulu. Kukho amaxesha apho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela, kubangela ukuba intliziyo yakho ibe nzima ngendlela ongenakuyichaza. Kodwa nceda, mamela kakuhle: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Khumbula ukuba uThixo akanguye uThixo wabafileyo, kodwa ngowabaphilayo. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. UBen ngoku ungumntu okhululekileyo, ophilileyo, ojonge phezulu kuThixo ngoncumo olufanayo nolokuba wayesemncinci, xa wayesadlala neebhaluni zakhe phambi kwe-fireplace. Ucinga ngelo phupha likaBawo, xa uBen wayemxelela ukuba 'test nào con cũng qua hết'—ukuba zonke iimvavanyo uziphumelele. UBen ukhuselekile. Uphumle kuthando lukaThixo.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakushiye; ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndikholelwa ukuba ukhona kule Ntsikelelo yeSakramente. Ndikuthanda ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku kwiSakramente yokuQhelana, nceda uze kum ngokomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ufikile, ndize ndizibophelele ngokupheleleyo kuwe. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Makube nathi usikelelo lukaThixo uSomandla, uYise, neNyana, noMoya oyiNgcwele. Hambani ngoxolo.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasemva abalilayo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba elingenakuphela.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuQala
readings.text: Mna Yohane, ndeva ilizwi livela ezulwini lisithi kum: Naba amangqina am amabini. Le yimithi yomnquma emibini neziphatho zezibane ezimbini ezime phambi kweNkosi yomhlaba. Ukuba kukho ofuna ukuwenzakalisa, umlilo uphuma emlonyeni wawo udle iintshaba zawo. Ngale ndlela, nabani na ofuna ukuwenzakalisa uya kubulawa. Anawo amandla okuvala isibhakabhaka ukuze imvula ingani ngexesha lokuprofeta kwawo. Anawo namandla okujika amanzi abe ligazi nokubetha umhlaba ngazo zonke izibetho nanini na akufunayo. Xa egqibile ubungqina bawo, irhamncwa elivela enzonzobileni laya kulwa nawo, liwoyise, libabulale. Izidumbu zawo ziya kuhlala esitratweni esikhulu sesixeko esikhulu, esinamagama angumfuziselo athi “Sodom” ne “Egypt,” apho iNkosi yawo yabethelwa khona. Abo baphuma kuzo zonke izizwe, imilowo, iilwimi, neentlanga baya kujonga izidumbu zawo iintsuku ezintathu nesiqingatha, kwaye abayi kuvumela ukuba izidumbu zawo zingcwatywe. Abemi bomhlaba baya kuvuya ngawo, banikane izipho, kuba aba baprofeti babini babebathuthumbisa abemi bomhlaba. Kodwa emva kweentsuku ezintathu nesiqingatha, umoya wobomi ovela kuThixo wangena kuwo. Xa ema ngeenyawo, uloyiko olukhulu lwehla kwabo babewabona. Emva koko, eva ilizwi elikhulu livela ezulwini lisithi kuwo, “Nyukani nize apha.” Ngoko ke anyukela ezulwini efini njengoko iintshaba zawo zazijonga.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Masibonge iNkosi, iLiwa lam! Masibonge iNkosi, iLiwa lam, oqeqesha izandla zam ekulweni, neminwe yam emfazweni. R. Masibonge iNkosi, iLiwa lam! Inceba yam nenqaba yam, inqaba yam, nomhlanguli wam, ikhaka lam endikholosa ngalo, othoba abantu bam phantsi kwam. R. Masibonge iNkosi, iLiwa lam! Thixo, ndiya kukuvumela ingoma entsha; ngohadi olunamalungu alishumi ndiya kucula indumiso yakho, Wena onika uloyiso ookumkani, nokuhlangula uDavide, umkhonzi wakho, kwikrele elibi. R. Masibonge iNkosi, iLiwa lam!

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Amanye amaSadusi, lawo aphika ukuba kukho uvuko, eza kuYesu, ambuza esithi, “Mfundisi, uMoses wasibhalela esithi, Ukuba umntu ufela ngumzalwana wakhe, eshiya umfazi kodwa engenabantwana, umzalwana wakhe makamthathe umfazi amzalisele abantwana umzalwana wakhe. Ngoko ke kwakukho abazalwana abasixhenxe; owokuqala watshata umfazi kodwa wafela engenabantwana. Owesibini nowesithathu bamthatha, kwatsho nabo bonke abasixhenxe bafela engenabantwana. Ekugqibeleni wafela nalomfazi. Ngoko ke eluvukweni, lo mfazi uya kuba ngumfazi kabani? Kuba bonke abasixhenxe babemthathile.” UYesu wathi kubo, “Abantwana beli xesha bayatshata kwaye bayaphinda batshate; kodwa abo bafunyenwe befanelekile ukufikelela kwixesha elizayo novuko lwabafileyo abatshati, kwaye abanikwa emtshatweni. Abanakufa kwakhona, kuba bafana neengelosi; kwaye bangabantwana bakaThixo kuba ngabo abaya kuvuka. Ukuba abafileyo baya kuvuka, uMoses wakwazisa oko kwisicatshulwa esimalunga nesihlahla, xa wabiza ‘iNkosi’ uThixo kaAbraham, uThixo kaIsake, noThixo kaYakobi; kwaye akanguye uThixo wabafileyo, kodwa ngowabaphilayo, kuba kuye bonke baphila.” Abanye bababhali baphendula bathi, “Mfundisi, uphendule kakuhle.” Kwaye abazange baphinde babe nabuganga bokumbuza nto.

day: Memorial of the Presentation of the Blessed Virgin Mary

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
